name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically and consistently the response flows from the context and previous utterances.

name: Relevance
description: Evaluates how closely the response aligns with the context and the provided interesting fact.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and uniqueness of the response, including the use of interesting facts and personal insights.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how well the response invites further conversation and maintains the interest of the interlocutor.

name: Factuality
description: Evaluates the accuracy and truthfulness of the information provided in the response.
